req.title: Partial update supported
req.statement: The system shall accept a partial payload on PUT /tasks/{task_id} and leave omitted fields unchanged.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-012 requires that PUT /tasks/{task_id} accepts a partial payload and leaves omitted fields unchanged. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — sending only one field updates that field and preserves others; (2) negative NEG — sending a partial payload to a non-existent task_id returns 404; (3) boundary BVA — updating title at its max length boundary (100 chars) while omitting other fields; (4) DT — updating each individual field independently to confirm isolation; (5) STC — state transition from completed=False to completed=True via partial payload. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200 not >=200), exact field values for both updated and untouched fields, and boundary constants (100-char title).

tests.name: test_partial_update_only_title_leaves_other_fields_unchanged
preconditions: App is running in-process with a fresh SQLite database
A task exists with known title, description, and completed=False
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a task with title='Original', description='Keep me', completed=False
PUT /tasks/{task_id} with payload {"title": "Updated"} (omitting description and completed)
expected: Response body id matches created task id
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_partial_update_only_title_leaves_other_fields_unchanged():
    client = TestClient(app)
    create_resp = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Original", "description": "Keep me", "completed": False})
    assert create_resp.status_code == 201
    task_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    update_resp = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": "Updated"})
    assert update_resp.status_code == 200
    body = update_resp.json()
    assert body["id"] == task_id
    assert body["title"] == "Updated"
    assert body["description"] == "Keep me"
    assert body["completed"] == False

test_partial_update_only_title_leaves_other_fields_unchanged()

tests.name: test_partial_update_title_at_max_length_boundary
preconditions: App is running in-process with a fresh SQLite database
A task exists with a short title and a description
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a task with title='Short', description='Desc', completed=False
PUT /tasks/{task_id} with payload {"title": <100-char string>} (exactly at max_length=100)
expected: Response body title has exactly 100 characters
trace: R-TASK-012: partial payload accepted at title boundary max_length=100
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_partial_update_title_at_max_length_boundary():
    client = TestClient(app)
    create_resp = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Short", "description": "Desc", "completed": False})
    assert create_resp.status_code == 201
    task_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    max_title = "A" * 100
    assert len(max_title) == 100
    update_resp = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": max_title})
    assert update_resp.status_code == 200
    body = update_resp.json()
    assert body["title"] == max_title
    assert len(body["title"]) == 100
    assert body["description"] == "Desc"
    assert body["completed"] == False

test_partial_update_title_at_max_length_boundary()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_partial_update_title_exceeds_max_length_returns_422():

tests.name: test_partial_update_only_completed_field_transitions_state
preconditions: App is running in-process with a fresh SQLite database
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a task with completed=False
PUT /tasks/{task_id} with payload {"completed": true} (omitting title and description)
expected: PUT response body title unchanged from creation
GET response body completed == True (state persisted)
trace: R-TASK-012: partial payload accepted — only completed field sent
R-TASK-012: omitted fields (title, description) left unchanged after state transition
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_partial_update_only_completed_field_transitions_state():
    client = TestClient(app)
    create_resp = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "My Task", "description": "Do it", "completed": False})
    assert create_resp.status_code == 201
    task_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    update_resp = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"completed": True})
    assert update_resp.status_code == 200
    body = update_resp.json()
    assert body["completed"] == True
    assert body["title"] == "My Task"
    assert body["description"] == "Do it"
    assert body["id"] == task_id

    get_resp = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 200
    assert get_resp.json()["completed"] == True

test_partial_update_only_completed_field_transitions_state()

tests.name: test_partial_update_each_field_independently_decision_table
preconditions: App is running in-process with a fresh SQLite database
Three separate tasks created with known initial values
actions: Create task1 with title='T1', description='D1', completed=False; update only description='D1-new'
Create task2 with title='T2', description='D2', completed=False; update only completed=True
Create task3 with title='T3', description='D3', completed=True; update only title='T3-new'
trace: R-TASK-012: each field can be independently updated while others remain unchanged
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_partial_update_each_field_independently_decision_table():
    client = TestClient(app)

    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "T1", "description": "D1", "completed": False})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
    u1 = client.put(f"/tasks/{id1}", json={"description": "D1-new"})
    assert u1.status_code == 200
    b1 = u1.json()
    assert b1["title"] == "T1"
    assert b1["description"] == "D1-new"
    assert b1["completed"] == False

    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "T2", "description": "D2", "completed": False})
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    id2 = r2.json()["id"]
    u2 = client.put(f"/tasks/{id2}", json={"completed": True})
    assert u2.status_code == 200
    b2 = u2.json()
    assert b2["title"] == "T2"
    assert b2["description"] == "D2"
    assert b2["completed"] == True

    r3 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "T3", "description": "D3", "completed": True})
    assert r3.status_code == 201
    id3 = r3.json()["id"]
    u3 = client.put(f"/tasks/{id3}", json={"title": "T3-new"})
    assert u3.status_code == 200
    b3 = u3.json()
    assert b3["title"] == "T3-new"
    assert b3["description"] == "D3"
    assert b3["completed"] == True

test_partial_update_each_field_independently_decision_table()
